description: Defines autograd functions for computing gradients, including backward and gradient calculations, as well as forward automatic differentiation levels, for the PyTorch library.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Computes the sum of gradients of given tensors with respect to graph leaves, accumulating gradients in leaf tensors.

methods.name: grad
methods.description: Computes and returns the sum of gradients of outputs with respect to inputs, supporting higher order derivatives.

methods.name: enter_dual_level
methods.description: Creates a new dual level for nested forward automatic differentiation, returning its index.

methods.name: exit_dual_level
methods.description: Exits a specified dual level, clearing gradients and restoring tensors to regular state.
